about_us.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Welcome to Pune Artisan Bakehouse, your neighborhood homebaker located in the heart of Baner, Pune. What started as a passion for baking has blossomed into a beloved local brand, known for our irresistible brownies, exquisite premium cakes, and a wide array of sweet treats.
Our menu is carefully crafted with love and the finest ingredients. From rich, fudgy brownies to custom celebratory cakes, every item is baked fresh to order, ensuring maximum flavor and freshness.
Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply craving a sweet indulgence, Pune Artisan Bakehouse is here to make your moments sweeter.
